long.title: 9 Weird Victorian Inventions That Got Real Patents (1895)

shorts.title: The U.S. Approved a Policeman's Hat With a Lamp
shorts.line: A policeman's hat with an electric lamp on the band, wired to a battery in your pocket. Really approved.

shorts.title: This Is a Real Patent for a Bicycle on Train Tracks
shorts.line: A third wheel on the opposite rail, and your bicycle follows the tracks. Really approved.

shorts.title: The U.S. Approved a Bicycle With a Roof and a Sail
shorts.line: A canopy for your bicycle that tilts into a sail. Really approved.

tiktok.title: The U.S. Approved a Policeman's Hat With a Lamp
tiktok.hook: A policeman's hat with an electric lamp on it. Approved.

tiktok.title: This Is a Real Patent for a Bicycle on Train Tracks
tiktok.hook: Approved or denied? A bicycle built to ride on railroad tracks.

tiktok.title: The U.S. Approved a Bicycle With a Roof and a Sail
tiktok.hook: A roof for your bicycle. Tilt it, and it is a sail.
